auditScope: local critical audit; independent review still pending

issues.title: Night lighting is visibly broken at city scale
issues.detail: Oversized white lamp discs cover aerial night views instead of restrained pools of warm light.

issues.title: Whole-scene triangles and heap exceed budget
issues.detail: W4 standard matrix peaks at 5,075,465 triangles; whole-game night reaches 7,498,104 and heap is 1,076.6 MB.

issues.title: Golden hour blows out the skyline
issues.detail: The 17:30 skyline loses a large part of the city to a near-white sun field.

issues.title: Density and asset variation remain synthetic
issues.detail: 612 buildings and repeated tower, foliage and lawn patterns remain below the city-scale target.

issues.title: Cross-seed utility reach remains below target
issues.detail: Fresh seed 7 reaches only 519/548 = 94.71% utility coverage and has no W4 proof that cross-seed restage is repaired.

issues.title: Bridge, waterfront and industry composition remain schematic
issues.detail: The districts read, but road-to-terrain/water joins, generic cranes and oversized flat smoke still look authored rather than lived-in.

strengths: All reviewed W4 frames are ready with zero console errors.
Primary-seed shared health-and-education coverage is now 60.36% through a real paid school.
Districts and fresh seed 7 remain readable and playable.
summary: 6.0 FAIL. W4 fixes primary-seed civic coverage but does not improve the visual tier. Night bloom, golden-hour exposure, density/repetition and whole-scene cost keep Democity far below the 8.5 bar.
